Client is on a 3-4 week waitlist for the Turn90 program. Primary immediate goal is to secure interim employment while waiting for program admission.

- Resume: None (Client has no prior work history as he was incarcerated at age 17). 

### Referrals/Resources Provided
- Will create and provide a functional resume based on client's GED and any skills acquired during incarceration.
- Will send information on the Scout Motors job fair happening on the 12th.
- Will send leads for second-chance employers in the Columbia area.

### Next Steps
- Daisy to draft a resume and send it to Tyler.
- Daisy to text job fair details and interim employment leads.
- Tyler to attend the job fair and apply for interim roles.
